detailed_description: The __Try On Anything__ workflow turns a person photo and clothing item images into multiple looks: a product-only layout showing all items in one frame, a white-background e‑commerce shot, a street-style image, scene-based magazine covers, two medium shots (with and without props), one drone shot, and a close-up portrait.

parameters.name: input_person_image
parameters.description: Upload the person/model photo (identity must be preserved).

parameters.name: input_top_image
parameters.description: Upload the top clothing reference image.

parameters.name: input_bottom_image
parameters.description: Upload the bottom clothing reference image.
